source_text: Order of Courage Order awarded to whoever followed the orders of the Commander of the Revolution on the night of the Great 1 September 1969, or undertook after that an outstanding act to protect the revolution and its thought and achievements and to defend it, presenting himself as a sacrifice. Libyan Arab Republic
